info.description:
TeincFood is a modular, event-driven order fulfillment system for food delivery.

## Authentication

All protected endpoints require an `Authorization` header with a Bearer token:
```
Authorization: Bearer <your_token>
```

## Key Features

- Complete order lifecycle management
- Real-time delivery tracking with GPS
- Automatic rider assignment via orchestration
- Event-driven architecture
- Geographic routing

## Authorization Model

The API uses a full **Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)** system with separate
`roles`, `permissions`, and `user_roles` tables.

### User Types

Every user has a `user_type` that determines their access boundary:

| Type | Description |
|---|---|
| `public` | External users (buyers, sellers, riders) |
| `internal` | Company staff (admins, support agents, etc.) |

### User Role (Metadata)

Public users can have a `user_role` field for classification (NOT a role for access control):

| Role | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `buyer` | public | Default role for all users. Can place orders. |
| `seller` | public | Business owner/merchant. Can manage menus and orders. |
| `rider` | public | Delivery rider. Can accept and complete deliveries. |
| `fleet_manager` | public | Fleet/vehicle management for delivery providers. |

### Internal Roles (Access Control)

Internal staff use roles for access control (assigned via `/api/v1/users/:id/roles`):

| Role | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `support_agent` | internal | Customer support representative. |
| `compliance_officer` | internal | KYC and compliance review. |
| `finance_admin` | internal | Finance and payment management. |
| `operations_admin` | internal | Operations and fleet oversight. |
| `admin` | internal | System administrator. Full RBAC management. |

### Super Admin

The `is_super_admin` boolean field on user records grants root-level access that bypasses all permission checks. It is **not** a role - it is a direct property on the user record.

### Permissions

Each role is linked to fine-grained permissions in `resource:action` format
(e.g. `orders:read`, `users:update`). Authorization checks can target either
roles or individual permissions.

### Endpoint Access Control

All protected endpoints use one of these authorization methods:
- **Ownership check**: User can only access their own resources (orders, wallet, etc.)
- **Permission check**: User needs specific permission (e.g., `users:read` for user listing)
- **Role check**: User needs specific role (e.g., `admin` for RBAC management)

No separate `/admin` scope - all endpoints use the unified permission system!

## WebSocket Pub/Sub Endpoints

Connect to realtime event streams using Phoenix Channels WebSocket:

```javascript
const socket = new Phoenix.Socket("/socket", {params: {token: "your_jwt_token"}})
socket.connect()
```

### Events Channel

The primary channel for realtime order, delivery, and payment events:

| Channel Topic | Description | Access Control |
|---|---|---|
| `events:{user_id}` | All domain events for the authenticated user | User only (actor, entity owner, or order participant) |

**How it works:** Join `events:{your_user_id}` after connecting. The server
automatically filters events — you only receive events where you are the actor,
the affected entity, or an order participant (buyer or business with `orders_read`).

The channel pushes events using the event type as the channel event name:

```javascript
socket.connect()
socket.joinChannel(`events:${userId}`)
  .then(() => console.log("Connected"))
  .catch(() => console.log("Connection failed"));

socket.onFrame(`events:${userId}`, ([_joinRef, _ref, _topic, event, payload]) => {
  // `event` is the event type string (e.g. "order.status_changed")
  // `payload` is the event data map
});
```

#### Order Events

| Event Type | Payload | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `order.created` | `{order_id, business_id, total, currency_code}` | New order placed |
| `order.status_changed` | `{order_id, from_status, to_status, ...metadata}` | Order status transition |

**`order.status_changed` payload fields:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `order_id` | string (UUID) | The order that changed |
| `from_status` | string | Previous status |
| `to_status` | string | New status |
| `notification_category` | string | Push notification category (e.g. `order_accepted`) |
| `action_required` | boolean | Whether the recipient needs to take action |
| `action_type` | string | Action type for notification buttons (e.g. `accept_order`, `accept_delivery`) |
| `rider_name` | string | Rider name (when assigning rider) |
| `rider_id` | string | Rider ID (when assigning rider) |

**Order status values:** `created`, `awaiting_payment`, `pending`, `accepted`, `preparing`, `ready`, `delivered`, `cancelled`

**Status transition rules:**
- `created` → `pending` (payment confirmed or pay-on-delivery)
- `pending` → `accepted` (business accepts)
- `accepted` → `preparing` (business starts preparing)
- `preparing` → `ready` (order ready for pickup/delivery)
- `ready` → `delivered` (rider delivers)
- Any non-terminal status → `cancelled`

#### Delivery Events

| Event Type | Payload | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `delivery.assigned` | `{delivery_id, order_id, rider_id, ...}` | Rider assigned to order |
| `delivery.status_changed` | `{delivery_id, order_id, from_status, to_status}` | Delivery status update |
| `delivery.pickup_confirmed` | `{delivery_id, order_id}` | Rider confirmed pickup |

**Delivery status values:** `pending`, `in_transit`, `delivered`, `failed`

#### Payment Events

| Event Type | Payload | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `payment.completed` | `{order_id, ...}` | Payment confirmed |
| `payment.failed` | `{order_id, ...}` | Payment failed |

#### Notification Events

| Event Type | Payload | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `notification_created` | `{notification: {id, title, body, type, payload, is_read, inserted_at}}` | In-app notification created |

---

### Push Notifications (FCM/APNs)

Mobile push notifications are sent automatically when relevant events occur.
Register your device token via `POST /api/v1/devices/push-token` to receive pushes.

**FCM Data Payload keys** (available in `remoteMessage.data`):

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `notification_category` | string | Category for routing (e.g. `order_accepted`, `order_preparing`, `order_ready`, `delivery_assigned`) |
| `action_required` | string | `"true"` if the recipient must take action |
| `action_type` | string | Action type for notification buttons (e.g. `accept_order`, `decline_order`, `accept_delivery`, `assign_rider`) |
| `order_id` | string | Associated order ID |
| `order_number` | string | Human-readable order number |
| `restaurant_name` | string | Restaurant name |
| `buyer_name` | string | Buyer name |
| `total_minor` | string | Order total in minor currency units |
| `status` | string | Current order status |
| `rider_name` | string | Rider name (for delivery notifications) |
| `from_status` | string | Previous status (for status change notifications) |
| `to_status` | string | New status (for status change notifications) |

**Notification categories and their meaning:**

| Category | Buyer | Business | Rider |
|---|---|---|---|
| `order_created` | Confirmation | "New order received" | — |
| `order_accepted` | "Restaurant accepted" | — | "New order to deliver" |
| `order_preparing` | "Restaurant is preparing" | — | — |
| `order_ready` | "Order ready" | — | "Order ready for pickup" |
| `order_cancelled` | "Order cancelled" | "Order cancelled" | "Order cancelled" |
| `delivery_assigned` | "Rider assigned" | "Rider assigned" | — |
| `delivery_pickup_confirmed` | "Rider picked up" | "Rider picked up" | — |
| `delivery_delivered` | "Order delivered" | "Order delivered" | — |

---

### Chat Channels

| Channel Topic | Description | Events | Access Control |
|---|---|---|---|
| `chat:support:{conversation_id}` | **Customer Support Chat** | `new_message`, `get_messages`, `typing`, `agent_joined` | User + Support Agents |
| `chat:pair:{user1_id}_{user2_id}` | **INTERNAL STAFF 1:1 CHAT** | `new_message`, `get_messages`, `typing` | Staff only |
| `chat:pair:order_{order_id}_{user1}_{user2}` | **ORDER-SCOPED 1:1 CHAT** | `new_message`, `get_messages`, `typing` | Order participants only |

**Important Chat Security Policies:**
- All communication is strictly private 1:1 only
- All chats are strictly scoped to an existing order context
- No open communication channels allowed between users
- Support agents can only access support chat channels

**Chat Connection Protocol:**

Chat channels are automatically created by the system. To connect to an internal staff 1:1 chat, always sort user IDs lexographically:

```javascript
const users = [currentUser.id, otherUser.id].sort()
const pairId = `${users[0]}_${users[1]}`

socket.channel(`chat:pair:${pairId}`)
  .join()
  .receive("ok", resp => { console.log("Staff chat connected") })
  .receive("error", resp => { console.log("Cannot connect", resp) })
```

**Chat Events:**

| Event | Payload | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `new_message` | `{user_id, content, sent_at, id}` | New chat message received |
| `get_messages` | Request: `{limit: number}`, Response: `{messages: [Message]}` | Load message history |
| `typing` | `{user_id}` | User is typing |
| `agent_joined` | `{user_id}` | Support agent joined conversation |

**Message History Sync (`get_messages`):**
```javascript
channel.push("get_messages", { limit: 50 })
  .receive("ok", (response) => {
    console.log("Messages loaded:", response.messages)
  })
```
